lead: One `CAPABILITIES` row makes the whole class capability-bearing, and every sibling member then owes a row of its own.
body: Adding `(Core\Cache, "shared", NetConnect)` is one line, and it turns `every_capability_bearing_member_declares_its_capability` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/capability.rs`) red on `Core\Cache::local`, a member that needs no grant; the allowlist that once took such members is gone rather than frozen, so a member that reaches nothing declares `None` in `registry::CAPABILITIES` beside a comment saying what it reaches instead. The class holding the *operations* is untouched, because a door is one class and the thing behind it is another (`Core\Cache\Store` declares nothing behind `Core\Cache::shared`; `Core\RateLimit\Decision` is its own `CoreClass`).
